Twenty First Centy Fox (FOX) Shares Rose While Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board Has Lowered Its Holding; As Apple Com (AAPL) Valuation Declined, Blue Fin Capital Has Upped Stake
May 12, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board decreased its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (FOX) by 40.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board sold 429,011 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.92% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 631,826 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $21.56 million, down from 1.06M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board who had been investing in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $69.92B market cap company. The stock increased 0.05% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $37.48. About 1.09 million shares traded. Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. (NASDAQ:FOX) has risen 15.46% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.91% the S&P500.
Blue Fin Capital Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 818.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Blue Fin Capital Inc bought 80,211 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 90,011 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.23 million, up from 9,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Blue Fin Capital Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
